item.title: Apple unveils powerhouse Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro and Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
item.summary: Apple has announced its latest powerhouse Mac computers with a new level of on-device AI – the Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro chips along with the new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra Apple silicon. They are available to pre-order today and will go on sale on September 22.
